<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key</small></p>


<p align="center">The notice is pinned beneath the brass star: &quot;No one should have to find their way through these trees alone.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">The nightkeeper left for one final journey and never returned. The ghost has been waiting ever since.</p>

<p align="center">Below the promise is a practical list: a living light, a steady current, a lens, a bearing. Someone expected this to be repairable.</p>
